steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Your company profile is what clients see on your paperwork. Let's fill it in.

steps.selector: text=Appears on estimates, invoices and the client portal.
steps.caption: Where it shows
steps.narration: It appears on estimates, invoices and the client portal.

steps.caption: Company name
steps.narration: Start with your company name. Legal entity is next to it.

steps.caption: Phone
steps.narration: Check the email and phone your clients should use. We'll update the phone.

steps.caption: Upload logo
steps.narration: Upload logo takes a PNG or JPG, up to two megabytes.

steps.caption: Address
steps.narration: Add your street address, city, state and ZIP.

steps.caption: License
steps.narration: Then your license number, and the state it's from.

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: Industry and Description say what your company does.

steps.caption: Saved
steps.narration: The CRM confirms: Company profile saved.

steps.caption: Menu: Settings
steps.narration: You'll find Company profile under Settings in the menu.

youtube.title: How to set up your company profile | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Company profile in the ConstructHUB CRM settings. You will check your company name, phone and address, see where the logo goes, add your license number, and save. The profile appears on estimates, invoices and the client portal.
